profile.summary: Goalbook is a company that makes Goalbook Toolkit, an online platform that helps special education teachers write Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) and plan specially designed instruction. It works with school districts across the United States.

review.notes: goalbook.com footer and Terms of Use name Enome, Inc. as the entity behind Goalbook, matching the agenda's 'Enome, Inc. dba Goalbook' and the special education contract; the summary, website, legalName and support@goalbook.com email (a generic business address) are all supported by the cited pages.
